findings.summary: Share flat pinned record schemas across compute binding declarations, binding sets and one-shot lowering.
Reuse the source store's cached shader-owner AST when locating packaged raw shaders.
Construct compute texture promise metadata once while preserving literal and retained option admission.
Derive uniform arena calls and native definitions from one function descriptor table.
Reuse submission-owned SDL compute binding scratch across dispatches.
Borrow cached compute binding groups and entries during ordered dispatch recording.
Validate volatile compute bindings through a nullable view instead of copying their collection.
Compare Dawn render texture allocation identities in existing storage without allocating on cached draws.
Remove ineffective exception-pointer and runtime-error moves; explicitly clear transferred command owners.
Reuse the same-process Ocean pause checkpoint instead of launching a redundant paused native phase.
Reuse shared pinned record emission for GPU timing records and snapshots, with an explicit local name to avoid source-variable shadowing.
Borrow compute task spans instead of allocating single-task vectors while collecting GPU timings.
Move final-use timing task arrays and owning snapshot fields instead of copying them during readback publication.
Share task timing scope cleanup across scene and standalone frame-graph renderers.
Represent an outstanding Window repaint with optional batch state instead of a separate pending flag.
Remove the unused compositor-clock callback interface and use its existing condition-variable notifications.
Reserve known native and public GPU timing task-array capacities before filling them.
